deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall entry are due February 15, and the catalog says they are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The PhD applicant must send GRE verbal, quantitative and analytical scores with a research-interests letter.
gre_general.quote: Applicants must submit a letter outlining tentative research interests and career goals along with GRE verbal, quantitative, and analytical test scores

entry_route.value: Applicants without a graduate degree normally start in the master's, though outstanding applicants can enter the PhD directly.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who do not have a graduate degree will normally request admission to the M.S. program first but, outstanding applications will be admitted directly into the Ph.D. program

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog lists assistantships and fellowships but does not say most students are funded.

notes: The MS minimums (GRE 370/144 verbal, 700/155 quantitative, TOEFL 570/230/89) are listed under the MS only and are not applied here.
